questions.subject: DATA_SCIENCE
questions.topic: A blank that means zero
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish a blank from zero in a building cost column
questions.stem: An architect sees a blank cost cell where the project had no expense.

options.text: Blank can be averaged as zero

questions.explanation: A blank with known no expense is a recorded zero-cost event, not unknown. Treating it as missing distorts budgets. Context decides meaning.
questions.hint: Context decides whether blank means zero.

questions.subject: DATA_SCIENCE
questions.topic: The value mean imputation writes
questions.stem: An architect fills missing room areas with the mean area.

answer.exemplar: Mean imputation writes the observed average area into each missing cell, preserving the column mean but reducing variance and ignoring feature relationships.

questions.explanation: Mean imputation copies the observed average. The column mean stays the same. Variance shrinks and relationships are ignored.
